skill.displayName: "运营-产品协同加速套件。解决运营与产品之间的信息不对称、需求扯皮、效果归因等痛点。用于：(1) 运营需求翻译为产品语言；(2) 效果归因框架生成；(3) 优先级智能计算；(4) 验收标准自动生成；(5) 数据口径对齐；(6) 协同文档生成。触发词：运营需求、产品协同、效果归因、需求扯皮、数据口径、验收标准、优先级评估。"

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ops-pm-bridge – a toolkit for streamlining collaboration between Operations and Product teams.

- Provides tools for translating operational requirements into product language and vice versa.
- Includes frameworks for effect attribution, priority calculation, and standardized acceptance criteria generation.
- Offers utilities for aligning data definitions and generating comprehensive collaboration documents in one click.
- Addresses common pain points such as miscommunication, requirement disputes, and inconsistent data metrics.
